negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, 3D CGI plastic skin, glossy CGI render, flat 2D digital drawing, cartoon vector, anime illustration, photorealistic real human flesh, deformed hands, missing fingers, extra limbs, modern digital technology, computer screens, plastic toys, oversaturated neon lighting
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion material authenticity (polymer clay skin, genuine knit yarn loops, real needle-felted wool hair) — AI often replaces handcrafted tactile textures with generic smooth CGI plastic
miniature architectural craftsmanship of birdhouses with balsa wood, twig railings, and thatch — AI frequently simplifies detailed miniature buildings into blurry indistinct boxes
exact hand-pencil interaction drafting fine lines on blueprint paper — AI often garbles hand gripping mechanics and pencil orientation
scale relationship between puppet craftsman, miniature birdhouses, and tiny lifelike songbirds — AI tends to hallucinate inconsistent scale or merge bird anatomy into wood
